title: Project Manager (Dev)
descriptionText:
Our Culture:

We want to change the world of B2B Trade through the advancement of technology. We are looking for someone who fits the startups culture - we are a young, happy, and motivated masterminds team. We are working together from all around the globe: USA, UAE, France, Russia, Australia, Pakistan, India, Philippines, Africa, KSA and Jordan forming an international mastermind alliance and bringing different cultures and prospects to the table. We do not operate with traditional management styles, thus we are looking for well organized, self-managed candidates that thrive independently just as well as with a team. The seven Key Values we look for in a candidate:

Dependability, if you say you will do it, you deliver on time
Loyalty, you believe in Aladdin and you stay with us through both the good and tough times
Ability to work under pressure, sometimes we have timely deadlines and we work long hours
Innovative, Smart thinking outside the box
Positive mentality, we are looking for happy mind & positive approach to life
Ability to go the extra mile, be a self starter, not only doing the job but do it better than anyone
Faith in Aladdin Vision and Mission, there’s nothing like a mastermind of people working towards a unified goal

AladdinB2B is looking for Project Manager - Technology Development :

We are seeking a highly skilled Development Project Manager to join our team and lead the development efforts for our product, Aladdin. As the Development Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the product development lifecycle, from conception to launch. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, designers, and product managers, to ensure the successful delivery of high-quality, scalable software solutions.

Responsibilities:

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of all development projects related to the Aladdin platform.
Define project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project schedules, resource plans, and budgets.
Coordinate with internal teams to prioritize tasks and allocate resources effectively.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize development processes and increase efficiency.
Ensure adherence to quality standards and best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
Act as a primary point of contact for all stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and addressing any concerns or inquiries.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in technology to inform decision-making and drive innovation within the organization.

Job Location: Remotely

Company Industry:

Technology, Big Data, B2B Trade

Job Role: Project Manager (Dev)

Joining Date: 2024

Employment Status: Full-time Contractor

Number of Vacancies: 1

Remote Monthly Salary: Attractive , USD 2000 - 3500

Manages Others: Yes

Number of days off/week: 2 DAYS Off / 22 days per years

Other: The successful candidate must have a strong communication skill and a positive attitude. Preferably in ages 30+ years old.

Job Specification:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
Proven experience (8 years) in project management, specifically in software development. Experience in the B2B or SaaS industry is a plus.
Strong understanding of software development methodologies, such as Agile and Waterfall.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies and tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities in a remote work environment.
Using AI Integration
Gulf Experience is a plus
Aladdin Academy Certified is required within the first month

Key Skills and characteristics:

Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Strong ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively.
Excellent communication skills especially in English language.
Attention to detail and accuracy in reporting
Strategic mindset to anticipate and address operational challenges.
Expertise in utilizing project management tools and software, especially ClickUp. Computer & software skills, Google Apps skills including Google calendar, Google docs, Google email, Google drive, Google forms and Google tasks.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on driving results and achieving organizational goals.
Proven ability to work effectively in a remote environment.
Flexibility to adapt to a dynamic and fast-paced startup environment.

title: Product Owner
descriptionText:
We're seeking passionate, driven, and self-motivated individuals to join our team. If you're eager to grow in a dynamic environment and be part of a company that’s at the forefront of AI innovation, this is your chance to hit the ground running.

VIDIZMO is a USA-based technology company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, and a Microsoft Solutions Partner in Data & AI, Infrastructure, and Digital & App Innovation. Offering a AI-Powered Intelligence Hub, we empower Fortune 500 companies, large enterprises, governments, and the public sector to securely manage, analyze, and govern their data with complete control and compliance.

Our Multimodal AI Data Intelligence Platform leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to deliver powerful capabilities such as auto-tagging, redaction, content summarization, OCR, translation, subtitle creation, object detection and tracking, content search, sentiment and emotion analysis, topic extraction, document classification, and facial attribute detection.

AI Output Verification & Accountability (Required Competency)

The candidate must be capable of effectively using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to support work outputs such as content, analysis, documentation, or code. However, the candidate must also demonstrate strong judgment and ownership of the final deliverables. AI-generated output must never be treated as final without review. The candidate is expected to validate accuracy, completeness, logic, compliance, and alignment with business requirements, and refine AI-assisted work to meet the expected quality standards. The individual will be held accountable for the final output, regardless of whether AI tools were used during execution.

Key Responsibilities:

Responsibility for reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs
Ownership of final deliverables, regardless of AI assistance
Ability to critically evaluate AI results and ensure they meet defined requirements
Accountability for accuracy, quality, and compliance

Job Description:

1. Define Vision and Product Roadmap with input from Product Manager, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success Teams
2. Breaking down and expanding Product Vision into Epics, Features and User Stories with Definition of Done
3. Prioritizing Epics, Features and User Stories aligned with Business Goals and their Business Impact
4. Work with Customer Success, Marketing and Sales teams to provide support to existing customers and as well as new prospects by prioritizing defects or new features
5. Work with Engineering Team to estimate Story Points or LOE using any other method
6. Employ methods to keep track of progress and bring visibility to team's progress
7. Organize Show n Tell, Perform Reviews and User Acceptance Testing of the Features developed by Engineering Team
8. Write articles about new Features or improvements made in the product for both Business as well as Technical Audience
9. Demonstrate and Evangelize new Product Features/Enhancements to other teams such as Marketing, Sales and Customer Success
10. Lead team of Product Analysts by setting Standards, Processes and Procedures to do their job
11. Hire and mentor Product Analysts
12. Contribute and Lead various SCRUM ceremonies like SCRUM Planning, Daily SCRUM, Sprint Review and Sprint Retrospective
13. Follow, Implement and Promote Agile Release Train methodology

Required Skills:

Ability to understand Product's Business as well as Technical sides
Excellent Decision making, Prioritizing and Negotiation skills
Good with Planning and Forecasting
Good Technical and Analytical Skills
Excellent Writing and Verbal Communication as well as Comprehension
Proven leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach and inspire at all levels
Must have worked as Project Manager or Product Owner before
Must have used Jira, Azure DevOps or any other ALM for managing backlogs
Strong collaboration and team working skills, with the ability to establish and maintain effective relationships cross-functionally and across all levels
Must have worked in team following SCRUM or other Agile methodology before

Ability to influence change and lead by example.

Essential Skills:

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong business acumen, translates objectives into impactful solutions, and effectively leverages AI tools for efficiency. Proficiency in Claude (mandatory) and familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT are required. An ownership mindset and the ability to deliver results independently are essential. Successful completion of a Claude-based assessment is required as part of the hiring process.

Benefits: Health Insurance (OPD/IPD), Separate Maternity Cover, Leave encashment, Car Support Program, Referral Bonus, EOBI, Bi-Annual Increment. Provident Fund, Career Growth, Bonus

Multiple Locations: Pakistan, India, UAE, Australia, Canada & USA (benefits vary based on location)

title: Training Manager - Sales
descriptionText:
Company Description

METRO opened its first cash & carry wholesale center in Pakistan in 2007 & expanded to 5 wholesale centers in a short span of 18 months. In July 2012 METRO and Makro-Habib combined their wholesale business in Pakistan marking the beginning of a long-term partnership to the mutual benefit of both companies. The merger allowed
METRO and Makro-Habib to combine resources and gain the financial strength to lead and grow in a challenging environment and to gain synergies targeted to generate value for our customers and suppliers alike. Today the company is operating 10 wholesale centers in Lahore, Karachi, Multan, Islamabad & Faisalabad.

METRO Pakistan (Pvt) Limited is part of METRO GROUP’s sales division METRO Cash & Carry, the international leader in self-service wholesale. The company operates more than 750 stores in 25 countries in Europe, Asia and Africa and has a workforce of over 107,000 employees. Sales in 2016/17 were approximately 37 billion Euro.

Job Description

SALES CAPABILITIES DEVELOPMENT

Works with sales leadership and learning partner to build a training strategy for our sales team.
Designs, develops, and delivers training curriculum and associated materials for sales staff on company products and selling skills, including but not limited to sales processes, negotiation, strategic selling, etc.
Maximizes OB / key account managers effectiveness by determining gaps and addressing training needs.
Creates evidence-based learning experiences that enhance sales performance.
Conducts learning need assessments, builds training content and curriculum across roles that requires sales focus.
Identify training needs during field visits, quizzes, detailing sessions etc. and create targeted improvement plans.
Delivers and track all training initiatives working within training deadlines and goals.
Field Coaching & On-the-Job Training: ensure implementation of selling skills in the field.
Conduct joint field visits with OB / KAM to assess performance and provide coaching on identified developmental needs.
Promote on the job coaching culture in the organization.
Facilitate line mangers in coaching plan.
Leads on-boarding for new sales employees with the talent team.
Works with internal subject matter experts in sales, offer, marketing, finance, etc to develop content & create training programs and materials.
Becomes an expert on Pakistan MDC and HoReCa strategy and value proposition and translates it into sales modules.

PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT

Develops and runs Sales Force certification process.
Coach sales employees and managers.
Keeps up to date on adult learning principles, modern learning tools, and learning technology trends.
Assist in creation of metrics to measure the success and effectiveness of our training.

Qualifications

Minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

Additional Information

Experience: 2 Years of relevant experience.

title: Human Resources Manager
descriptionText:
Company Description

Established in 2019, XPROLABS is a technology, consultancy and services firm with a focal point of helping and assisting organizations to precedent amidst radical business and technology solutions.

XPROLABS helps your online business to determine software development needs and create specific steps that will improve your performance faster.

We are a top IT service provider company that works on a variety of intense, challenging projects involving building new products from the ground up. In this role, you may be responsible for handling everything from architecture for a new product to building out cutting edge UI.

Job Description

Xprolabs has a long history of engaged, productive employees, and we’re looking for a Human Resources (HR) manager to continue that happy tradition. The ideal candidate will have prior experience in HR or recruitment, with a thorough understanding of HR policy and procedures. The bulk of the role will involve employee orientations, benefits administration, compensation, rewards, and conflict resolution, but there is great opportunity for developing and refining systems. We are eager to find an HR manager who easily connects with people and has a detail-oriented mindset to handle the changing nature of the workforce.

Daily and Monthly Responsibilities

Consistently recruiting excellent staff
Maintaining a smooth onboarding process
Training, counseling and coaching our staff
Resolving conflicts through positive and professional mediation
Carrying out necessary administrative duties
Conducting performance and wage reviews
Developing clear policies and ensuring policy awareness
Creating clear and concise reports
Giving helpful and engaging presentations
Maintaining and reporting on workplace health and safety compliance
Leading a team of junior human resource managers
Maintaining employee and workplace privacy
Plan, monitor, and appraise HR activities by scheduling management conferences with employees, hearing and resolving employee grievances, training managers to coach and discipline employees, and counselling employees and supervisors
Handle confidential matters with discretion

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in human resources
3+ years in human resources or recruitment
Exceptional communication skills, writing skills, interpersonal skills, and ethical mindset
Adept to problem-solving and conflict resolution
Extensive knowledge of HR policies and systems
Familiarity with HR software and working knowledge of MS Office

descriptionText:
*About Distimax:*

Distimax offers the largest selection of refurbished Datacentre IT hardware in the southern hemisphere. As a leading supplier to end Users, IT Companies and third-party maintenance companies, we have built a strong reputation in the industry over the past 19 years.

Our ecommerce model is a key platform for success. We also do a lot of direct manual sales with customers all over the world via various sales channels. Our testing systems and processes are also a key differentiator.

*About the Role:*

We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Senior Finance / Finance Manager to own and manage Distimax's end-to-end financial operations from our Philippines office. This is a pivotal role for a seasoned financial professional with at least 10 years of progressive experience who can bridge day-to-day bookkeeping with strategic financial management in a cross-border business environment.

You will work closely with the General Manager and Managing Director, serving as a trusted financial partner who ensures the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of all financial activities across our Australia and other countries entities — while actively contributing to the company's long-term commercial goals.

*Bookkeeping & Accounting Operations*

* Manage all daily financial transactions including accounts payable/receivable, general ledger maintenance, journal entries, and bank reconciliations across AU and other countries entities
* Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing for employees in Australia and the Philippines, in compliance with applicable tax regulations, BIR requirements, and Australian payroll obligations
* Prepare, review, and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, management reports, and regulatory submissions
* Maintain an audit-ready system of financial records and documentation across both jurisdictions
* Monitor and reconcile balance sheet accounts, identifying and resolving discrepancies promptly
* Coordinate with external auditors, tax agents, and regulatory bodies

* Develop, monitor, and analyze annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and cash flow projections to support strategic decision-making by senior leadership
* Deliver clear financial analysis, variance reports, and performance dashboards to the General Manager and Managing Director
* Identify financial risks and opportunities across the business, providing actionable recommendations to optimize performance
* Ensure ongoing compliance with Australian accounting standards, regulations in all applicable financial laws
* Design, implement, and continuously improve financial controls, policies, and internal procedures suited to a distributed team environment
* Support business cases, pricing strategies, and investment decisions through financial modeling and scenario analysis
* Contribute to long-term financial planning aligned with Distimax's growth strategy across the APAC region

*Experience & Qualifications*

* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in bookkeeping and financial management
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA licensure is highly preferred
* Proven experience managing financial operations across multi-currency and cross-border environments (AU/PH exposure is a strong advantage)
* Background in IT distribution, technology, or product-based businesses is an advantage

* Strong expertise in accounting principles, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance (both PH and AU context)
* Proficiency in accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, or QuickBooks — experience with Australian-compliant platforms preferred
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills including financial modeling, pivot tables, and dashboards
* Experience with payroll systems, Australian payroll obligations (Superannuation, PAYG)
* Familiarity with cloud-based tools and distributed team workflows (e.g., Google Workspace)

* High degree of numerical accuracy and analytical thinking

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities across time zones

* Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a remote/hybrid setup
* Collaborative team player who can build strong relationships

* A key seat at the table in a growing, internationally connected IT distribution company

* Direct collaboration with senior leadership (GM and MD)

* Supportive, entrepreneurial team culture with real opportunities for career growth

About Distimax:

Distimax offers the largest selection of refurbished Datacentre IT hardware in the southern hemisphere. As a leading supplier to end Users, IT Companies and third-party maintenance companies, we have built a strong reputation in the industry over the past 19 years.

Our ecommerce model is a key platform for success. We also do a lot of direct manual sales with customers all over the world via various sales channels. Our testing systems and processes are also a key differentiator.

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Senior Finance / Finance Manager to own and manage Distimax's end-to-end financial operations from our Philippines office. This is a pivotal role for a seasoned financial professional with at least 10 years of progressive experience who can bridge day-to-day bookkeeping with strategic financial management in a cross-border business environment.

You will work closely with the General Manager and Managing Director, serving as a trusted financial partner who ensures the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of all financial activities across our Australia and other countries entities — while actively contributing to the company's long-term commercial goals.

Key Responsibilities:

Bookkeeping & Accounting Operations

  • Manage all daily financial transactions including accounts payable/receivable, general ledger maintenance, journal entries, and bank reconciliations across AU and other countries entities
  • Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing for employees in Australia and the Philippines, in compliance with applicable tax regulations, BIR requirements, and Australian payroll obligations
  • Prepare, review, and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, management reports, and regulatory submissions
  • Maintain an audit-ready system of financial records and documentation across both jurisdictions
  • Monitor and reconcile balance sheet accounts, identifying and resolving discrepancies promptly
  • Coordinate with external auditors, tax agents, and regulatory bodies

Financial Management & Strategy

  • Develop, monitor, and analyze annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and cash flow projections to support strategic decision-making by senior leadership
  • Deliver clear financial analysis, variance reports, and performance dashboards to the General Manager and Managing Director
  • Identify financial risks and opportunities across the business, providing actionable recommendations to optimize performance
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with Australian accounting standards, regulations in all applicable financial laws
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve financial controls, policies, and internal procedures suited to a distributed team environment
  • Support business cases, pricing strategies, and investment decisions through financial modeling and scenario analysis
  • Contribute to long-term financial planning aligned with Distimax's growth strategy across the APAC region

Experience & Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in bookkeeping and financial management
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA licensure is highly preferred
  • Proven experience managing financial operations across multi-currency and cross-border environments (AU/PH exposure is a strong advantage)
  • Background in IT distribution, technology, or product-based businesses is an advantage

Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise in accounting principles, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance (both PH and AU context)
  • Proficiency in accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, or QuickBooks — experience with Australian-compliant platforms preferred
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills including financial modeling, pivot tables, and dashboards
  • Experience with payroll systems, Australian payroll obligations (Superannuation, PAYG)
  • Familiarity with cloud-based tools and distributed team workflows (e.g., Google Workspace)

Core Competencies

  • High degree of numerical accuracy and analytical thinking
  • Ability to manage sensitive financial information with absolute discretion and integrity
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities across time zones
  • Excellent communication skills — able to translate financial data into clear insights for non-finance stakeholders including the Managing Director and department heads
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a remote/hybrid setup
  • Collaborative team player who can build strong relationships

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • A key seat at the table in a growing, internationally connected IT distribution company
  • Flexible work arrangement
  • Direct collaboration with senior leadership (GM and MD)
  • Opportunity to shape and professionalize the financial function of an expanding business
  • Supportive, entrepreneurial team culture with real opportunities for career growth

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs1,400.00 - Rs2,240.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

descriptionText:

The ideal candidate has a strong background in technology and a proven track record of managing complex product backlogs and cross-functional teams.

* *Experience:* Minimum of *5 years* of experience in Product Management.
* *Education:* BS in *Computer Science, Electrical Engineering*, Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related technical role.
* *Industry:* Prior experience within the technology sector is required.

descriptionText:
Our platform includes pre-configured interactive environments. This allows learners to practice their new skills right away with no additional setup on their machines. The courses weave in quizzes and coding challenges to enhance learning, and the test code can even be deployed so the learner can see what he/she has built. This is a far cry from the all too common one-size-fits-all video monologues.

You'll join a small team of product managers and will help us grow from 2 million developers. In addition, you’ll help us increase our enterprise customer base to hundreds of organizations.

You will work directly with the co-founders of Educative. This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants to lead the product vision for a V1 product where we have already achieved product-market fit and are focused on scaling to change how developers will learn new technologies in this decade.

You will be an individual contributor with the freedom to think strategically and make data-driven decisions, and the ability to drive significant impact to the customer experience and the business.

The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with a passion for building a world-class service and have a high level of flexibility and commitment. You'll shape company strategy in a rapidly evolving environment. With stakeholders spanning the company - Sales, Marketing, Content, and Engineering - you'll have frequent opportunities to influence significant decisions.
In this role, you will be responsible for the following areas:
Define, design, launch and measure new features to drive improved profitability and discovery of products, resulting in growth and superior customer experience.
Define, collect, and measure key metrics to communicate success/failure with executive leadership and relevant stakeholders.
Own the long-term vision and roadmap for Educative products as it matures, maintain a deep competitive awareness and think big to identify global business opportunities worthy of investment.
Determine root causes, develop business cases, test/implement solutions and prioritize competing opportunities.
Operate with significant autonomy to deliver results and achieve the goals and objectives of both your team and the broader organization.
About you:
Bachelor’s, Master’s degree or Ph.D. in computer science, engineering or related field.
3+ years of Product Management experience (i.e. creating strategic product roadmap(s) from conception to launch and working with cross-functional teams).
Experience driving the product vision, go-to-market strategy, and design discussions. Familiarity or experience with design thinking processes.
Proven track record of prioritizing high impact activities and keeping complicated projects moving forward, working with cross-functional teams.
Proven experience delivering technology products/services in a high growth environment with a demonstrated ability to translate customer needs into business and product requirements.
Superior analytical and quantitative skills; experience using data and metrics to independently test theories, confirm assumptions, and measure success with extreme attention to detail.
Excellent customer experience intuition; demonstrated success in creating innovative and user-friendly products and customer-facing features.
Technical fluency; comfort understanding and discussing technical concepts, schedule tradeoffs and new opportunities with technical team members.
Strong written and verbal communication and persuasion skills.
Experience with eLearning/education applications preferred
You are a Recruiter! Educative hires company builders and, in this role, you will be asked to be on the constant lookout for the best talent to bring on board to help us continue to build Educative
About Educative:
Educative is a hands-on learning platform for software developers of all levels. We were founded by industry veterans who understand first-hand the problems developers face staying on the cutting edge of modern technology. Educative's interactive, text-based courses are built to teach you the skills employers are looking for. We provide tools like in-browser coding environments and interview-focused assessments to help you practice as you learn.

Educative is connecting millions of developers worldwide to become a developer, grow their skills, or prepare for an interview.

Our learners rely on us to create engaging courses to get better at their job, find a better job, or experience the joy of learning. With the courses that you create, learners can maximize their success.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionText:
Role Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the evolution of a cutting-edge AI-powered digital testing and evaluation platform. The Senior Product Manager will drive the strategic direction and product roadmap, ensuring the successful deployment and scaling of the solution for large-scale government and institutional use. The role requires deep experience in product management, AI-native development, and large-scale systems deployment, with a focus on AI-driven innovation and rapid prototyping.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Vision: Define and articulate the vision and roadmap for the existing digital exam system, aligning it with organizational goals and market demands.

AI Integration: Lead efforts to modernize the solution with AI capabilities, leveraging tools like Cursor, AntiGravity, and similar platforms to enhance the product's functionality.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with engineering, operations, and design teams to iterate on product development, ensure technical feasibility, and oversee deployment.

Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with public-sector organizations, educational institutions, and test centers to ensure the platform meets their needs at scale.

Product Launch & Scaling: Manage the product's new features lifecycle, from ideation through to large-scale deployment, ensuring seamless scaling and adaptability for diverse users.

Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data insights and analytics to measure product performance, user satisfaction, and identify areas for improvement.

Continuous Improvement: Lead rapid product experimentation, incorporating feedback and making adjustments to drive continuous growth.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

5+ years of product management experience, with a strong focus on enterprise SaaS, digital platforms.

Proven experience leading product development for large-scale systems in the public or private sector, particularly in education or testing industries.

Deep understanding of AI-native product development, including prototyping with Figma, experimentation, and rapid deployment.

Strong understanding of UX Laws and technical background to get them implemented, with the ability to engage with engineering teams on complex technical issues.

Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with AI-driven development tools such as Cursor or AntiGravity.

Experience in managing complex products in government or public-sector environments.

Familiarity with secure cloud-based infrastructures, testing platforms, and large-scale data systems.

Experience with integrating biometric and face recognition technologies into product offerings.

Technical Competencies:

Excellent understanding of AI-based Product Development.

Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, etc.) and serverless architectures.

Data Analytics and Reporting Systems.

Familiarity with secure testing and verification systems (face recognition, biometrics, etc.).

Product Management Expectations:

Strategic Thinking: Ability to define the product’s long-term vision, anticipate challenges, and make data-informed decisions.

Leadership: Proven track record of successfully leading product teams and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver impactful products.

Customer-Centric Focus: Deep understanding of the needs of candidates, administrators, and test centers in large-scale environments.

Innovation: Strong focus on experimenting and incorporating AI to deliver differentiated product features.

Deployment Success: Timely and successful deployment of the solution across target public-sector organizations.

Scalability: Successful scaling of the platform to handle large volumes of users and testing environments.

Stakeholder Management Responsibilities:

Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders within the public sector, educational institutions, and test centers.

Communicate product progress, milestones, and insights to stakeholders, ensuring alignment on expectations and timelines.

Manage expectations, addressing any concerns or issues promptly and maintaining transparency throughout the product lifecycle.

title: Quality Control Manager
descriptionText:
The Quality Control Manager will lead and oversee all Quality Control operations in the pharmaceutical manufacturing facility. The role is responsible for ensuring compliance with GMP and regulatory standards, managing QC teams, and maintaining high-quality testing, documentation, and release processes.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Lead and manage all Quality Control activities in compliance with GMP, GLP, and regulatory requirements
* Oversee analytical and microbiological testing, data review, and product release activities
* Ensure compliance with DRAP, WHO, ISO, and other applicable regulatory standards
* Manage, train, and develop QC team members to maintain performance and compliance
* Review, approve, and maintain SOPs, test methods, protocols, validation documents, and investigation reports
* Ensure proper operation, calibration, and maintenance of analytical instruments
* Support internal and external audits, inspections, and regulatory visits

* Minimum 15 years of total experience in Pharmaceutical Quality Control
* At least 5 years of experience in a managerial or supervisory QC role
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacy, or a related discipline

*Skills & Competencies*

* Strong expertise in analytical techniques and instruments (HPLC, GC, UV, IR)
* Solid understanding of microbiological testing and quality compliance requirements
* In-depth knowledge of GMP, GLP, DRAP, WHO, and ISO standards
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Excellent documentation, reporting, and communication abilities

Pay: Rs150,000.00 - Rs200,000.00 per month

title: Product Manager
descriptionText:
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Product Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing the entire product lifecycle, from conception to launch. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including development, design, marketing, and sales to ensure successful product delivery.
Meet Unduit

Located in the heart of Chicago, one of the most vibrant cities in the USA, Unduit is on the mission to transform ITAD (IT Asset Disposition) industry through its proprietary app-based platform. The platform allows enterprises to build custom programs by utilizing relevant apps and integrations into existing technology platforms to 1) drive a dramatic reduction in the cost of ownership of assets, 2) enhance device-level security through a chain of custody, and 3) enhance productivity and collaboration across IT team on a global level for asset management. For more details please visit: https://www.unduit.com/

Responsibilities:
Define and drive the product strategy in alignment with the company’s overall business goals and objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders, including clients and internal teams, to gather and prioritize product requirements.
Clearly articulate product requirements through user stories, wireframes, and other relevant documentation.
Work closely with development, design, and QA teams to ensure timely and successful delivery of product features and enhancements.
Provide guidance and direction to development teams, ensuring they have a clear understanding of product goals and priorities.
Develop and maintain a product roadmap that outlines key milestones, features, and releases.

title: Product Manager
descriptionText:
Job Description

We’re looking for a sharp, data-driven Product Manager to take ownership of one of our exciting casual titles! This is a full-time, remote position for a product champion ready to manage the daily heartbeat of a game featuring a massive global IP. You will be the "CEO of your product," ensuring that fans of this beloved universe enjoy a fresh, engaging, and balanced experience every time they log in.

About UserWise

UserWise is a fast-growing game services company that partners with top studios to scale and operate games reaching millions of players. We specialize in LiveOps, product strategy, game development, and monetization – with a strong focus on speed, quality, and creative impact. Our partners include iconic IPs and leading publishers across mobile and hybrid-casual games.

Key Responsibilities
Own the Roadmap: Take full responsibility for the product lifecycle of a specific casual title (Arcade, Puzzle, or Trivia), driving the feature roadmap from concept to launch.
LiveOps Execution: Manage the in-game event calendar, ensuring a constant stream of engaging content that maximizes retention and monetization without burning out players.
Feature Specification: Write clear, detailed PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) and wireframes for new features, ensuring the Engineering and Art teams have a crystal-clear vision of the goal.
IP Integration: Act as the guardian of the brand within the game, ensuring that all events and features authentically represent the IP while delivering fun gameplay.
Data Analysis & Tuning: Monitor game KPIs daily. Analyze the effectiveness of features and economy changes, running A/B tests to optimize the player journey.
Economy Management: Balance the game economy to ensure a healthy ecosystem that rewards engagement while driving revenue growth.
Sprint Leadership: Collaborate closely with the development team during sprints to unblock issues, prioritize tasks, and ensure high-quality delivery.

Requirements

3+ years of experience in Product Management within the mobile gaming sector.
Casual Genre Fluency: Strong understanding of casual game mechanics, specifically in arcade, puzzle, or trivia categories.
LiveOps Experience: Proven experience running live operations, including event scheduling, sales, and content updates.
Data Proficiency: Comfort using analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Amplitude, SQL) to derive insights and justify product decisions.
Spec Writing: Ability to translate complex game concepts into simple, actionable documentation for developers.
IP Sensitivity: Experience working with branded content or IPs is a strong plus.
Collaborative Spirit: Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between creative, technical, and business teams.
Fluent in English.

Benefits

Market competitive USD salaries
Paid Time Off
Performance Bonus
Annual Performance Reviews

title: Product Manager
descriptionText:
Beam AI builds self-learning AI agents and an organisational operating system where intelligence grows through autonomous discovery. We help enterprises evolve from AI-curious to AI-native with automation that delivers results today and learns to improve itself over time. Join us in shaping a future where AI continuously discovers, adapts, and makes work more meaningful. To learn more, visit https://beam.ai/.

About the Team

Beam’s product team operates at the intersection of AI, engineering, and real-world utility. We don’t just build features; we are defining how humans and agents collaborate. We work closely with customers to turn complex agentic workflows into intuitive, high-leverage tools. Our PMs are not just backlog curators, they are product architects who work hand-in-hand with engineering to solve ambiguous problems in a rapidly evolving technical landscape.

About the Role

We’re looking for an AI-native Product Manager to own a core vertical of the Beam platform. You will move beyond simple execution to define the "what" and the "why" of what we build.

In this role, you will act as a player-coach for your product area. You will be responsible for customer discovery, roadmap definition, and end-to-end delivery. Crucially, you will be a "power user" of our own technology, using Beam agents to automate the repetitive parts of product management (like sprint updates, data analysis, and ticket hygiene) so you can focus on strategy and user empathy. This is a role for a builder who wants to define the future of work, not just document it.

Responsibilities
Own the Roadmap: Define the product vision and strategy for your vertical, translating high-level business goals into actionable specs and prioritised roadmaps.
Deep Customer Discovery: Regularly engage with customers to uncover pain points, validate hypotheses, and ensure we are solving the right problems, not just the easy ones.
Lead the Squad: Partner deeply with Engineering and Design to drive features from concept to launch. You are responsible for the tempo and quality of your squad’s output.
Dogfood & Automate: Act as "Customer Zero." Design and manage internal Beam agents to automate your own PM workflows and stress-test our platform's capabilities.
Data-Driven Iteration: Define success metrics for your features. Monitor usage data to make informed decisions on when to iterate, kill, or double down.
Ruthless Prioritisation: Balance the needs of enterprise customers, technical debt, and long-term innovation in a high-velocity environment.

Requirements

3+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS or complex technical products.
0-to-1 Mindset: You have experience taking a vague concept and turning it into a shipped product. You are comfortable with ambiguity.
Technical Fluency: You don’t need to write production code, but you must be able to discuss APIs, data models, and technical trade-offs with engineers.
AI-Curious / AI-Native: You actively use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, etc.) in your daily workflow and have a strong grasp of how LLMs and agents function.
Excellent Communication: You can write clear, concise specs and communicate complex ideas effectively to both engineers and executives.

Nice to Have

Experience building or managing products that utilise LLMs or Generative AI.
Background in workflow automation, low-code/no-code platforms, or developer tools.
Basic coding ability (Python/JS) to build your own prototypes or scripts.

Benefits

At Beam, we’re building an environment where ambitious people can do their best work, with clarity, purpose, and room to grow. We’re thoughtful about what we build, how we work, and who we hire. The problems we’re solving are real. The systems we’re building are complex. And the people here care deeply, about craft, about speed, and about doing work that actually matters. You won’t find rigid hierarchies or endless process here. You’ll find high trust, high standards, and a team driven by curiosity, ownership, and long-term thinking.

Our culture is shaped by our values in action:

AI-native thinking: Every teammate thinks in agentic workflows, uses AI tools daily, and looks for leverage through automation. AI isn’t just what we build, it's how we operate.
Customer obsession: We build with urgency and empathy, speak to customers early and often, and measure success through their outcomes.
Speed as a habit: We ship fast, learn faster, and prioritize unblocking over perfection. We favour small experiments with tight feedback loops.
Leverage-focused execution: We hire high-impact players, invest in the 20% that drives 80% of results, and value candid feedback.
Highly aligned, loosely coupled: We align on outcomes, not tasks. You’ll work independently, but never in isolation.
Data-driven, human-guided: We seek clarity over comfort, speak up early, and use feedback to grow together.

If this sounds like the kind of work you want to do and the kind of team you want to grow with, we’d love to hear from you!

descriptionText:
*About ICT*

ICT Distribution is a leading technology distributor in the APAC region, specializing in enterprise solutions, IT hardware, software, and advanced technology infrastructure. Headquartered in Sydney, Australia, ICT supports a strong channel ecosystem across South and Southeast Asia.

*About the Role*

The *Product Manager – Supermicro* will be responsible for managing ICT’s Supermicro server and storage product portfolio across the APAC region. You will drive product strategy, market development, vendor engagement, and channel enablement to grow Supermicro’s presence and revenue.

This role requires strong technical understanding of enterprise hardware, market insights, and the ability to work closely with vendors, partners, and internal teams.

*ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy & Market Development*

* Define the growth strategy for the Supermicro product line across South Asia.
* Analyze server, storage, and data center market trends to identify opportunities.
* Develop product positioning, pricing strategies, and competitive comparisons.

*Vendor Management (Supermicro)*

* Serve as the primary point of contact for Supermicro.
* Manage vendor programs, certifications, updates, and incentive structures.
* Coordinate product training, roadmap briefings, and joint marketing initiatives.

*Channel & Partner Enablement*

* Support channel partners with product information, solution configuration, quotations, and positioning.
* Conduct partner enablement sessions and technical briefings.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with distributors, system integrators, and enterprise customers.

*Sales Support & Pre-Sales Coordination*

* Provide support to sales teams with configurations, BOM creation, and technical product details.
* Assist in preparing proposals, bids, and customer presentations.
* Ensure accurate and timely communication of lead times, pricing, and product updates.

*Lifecycle & Operations Management*

* Manage the full product lifecycle, including new product introductions (NPI) and end-of-life (EOL).
* Track stock availability, sell-through, and forecast demand in coordination with logistics and procurement teams.
* Ensure accurate product documentation and specification materials.

*Performance Tracking & Reporting*

* Monitor revenue, margin performance, and market penetration for the Supermicro line.
* Prepare regular reports and recommendations for leadership on growth initiatives.
* Identify operational gaps and propose improvements.

*Qualifications*

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4–7+ years of experience in product management, pre-sales, or enterprise hardware solutions.
* Strong knowledge of *server, storage, and data center technologies*—Supermicro experience preferred.
* Experience working with vendors, distributors, and enterprise customers.

*Skills*

* Strong technical understanding of enterprise servers and configurations.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* Strong analytical abilities in pricing, forecasting, and product performance tracking.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with ERP/CRM tools is beneficial.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple product lines.

Contact Us to Apply

Submit your CV to: recruitment@ictdistribution.net with email subject PKT-PMS-"YourFullName"

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs100,000.00 - Rs150,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Associate Product Manager
descriptionText:
Overview:

Arkhitech is seeking Associate Product Manager who can manage advanced internet applications, produce interactive mobile applications, and ensure high quality of deliverables.

Major Duties & Responsibilities:

Managing the entire product line life cycle from strategic planning to tactical activities
Specifying market requirements for current and future products by conducting market research supported by ongoing visits to customers and non-customers.
Driving a solution set across development teams (primarily Development/Engineering, and Marketing Communications) through market requirements, product contract, and positioning.
Developing and implementing a company-wide go-to-market plan, working with all departments to execute.
Analyzing potential partner relationships for the product.
Assesses market competition by comparing the company's product to competitors' products, and through other methods such as customer surveys.
Gain a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth.
Developing product pricing and positioning strategies
Translating product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes
Adhering to Arkhitech's policies, standards and procedures in the performance of job duties.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Undergraduate or Graduate degree in Computer Sciences.
1+ years of software marketing/product management experience.
Hands-on experience in creating wireframes and mockups using Moqups or similar tools.
Good verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
High energy level with strong motivation to meet delivery deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Key Benefits:

Competitive salaries
Bi-annual performance bonus
Daily lunch allowance and attendance bonus
Accelerated learning and career growth!
